knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Tying the bag, tipping the bin, and bending at the knees keeps the load close and the back straight.
Bags are placed by hand at the bin. Throwing from a distance is not permitted practice.
Hidden sharps are a risk, so waste is not pressed down by hand or foot.

practicalCriteria: Ties the bag, tips the bin and draws the bag out while bending at the knees.
Checks the bag weight and splits any bag that cannot be carried comfortably by one person.
Places the bag into the outside bin by hand, and does not throw or lean into the bin.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of one full bag removal and disposal
Incident report, if any strain occurs
stopWorkCriteria: Bag thrown into an outside bin
Waste pressed down by hand or foot
